title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-08-01
description:
Merged 2 ibm security advisories published on 2026-08-01. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7282303, IBM-7282302

Titles:
- IBM Storage Protect Client and Virtual Environments are vulnerable to weaker than expected security controls in IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty (CVE-2025-14923)
- IBM Storage Protect Client and Virtual Environments are affected by weaker than expected security in IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty (CVE-2025-14917)

cves.title: CVE-2025-14917
cves.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.3 IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty could provide weaker than expected security when administering security settings

cves.title: CVE-2025-14923
cves.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.2 IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty could provide weaker than expected security when using the Security Utility when administering security settings
